text.p: These are the leading stories in the Lebanese press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Elias Hrawi says the positive aspects of Pope visit to Lebanon last weekend will show up soon.
- Russian Communist leader Gennady Zyuganov, during visit to Lebanon lasting a few hours, says Russia must play a more active in the region.
- Police arrest three men suspected of being Satan worshipers.
- Prime Minster Rafik al-Hariri, on a three-day visit to South Korea, says Lebanon is a major economic centre in the Middle East.
- Palestinean refugee camps go on one-day strike in protest marking Israel's independence day.
- Pro-Israeli militia releases three Lebanese detainees.
